slides.title: Welcome!
dialogue: Nice to meet you! I'm **Beaker**, the official ChatGPT Lab mascot and self-appointed event planner.
Looks like you're ready to host a Lab event on your campus—I'm here to help you make it happen.
I'll walk you through planning it step by step. Feel free to leave anytime; whenever you come back, your progress will be saved.

slides.title: What's a ChatGPT Lab?
dialogue: Quick reminder: you'll be hosting a **one-hour, peer-led show-and-tell** where students share how they're actually using AI.
Your goal isn't to teach everyone AI—it's to have them leave with a few new ways to use it, plus the curiosity and confidence to try something new.
Feel free to get creative with your event. I'll give you a structure, but it's yours to shape.

slides.title: Here's how we'll support you
dialogue: I've convinced OpenAI to send you some **100 Chats books**—they're great for sparking conversation.
You'll also join a community of students hosting Labs at their own campuses. You can swap ideas, learn what's working, and steal shamelessly from each other.
And if your event goes well, we might feature it to the broader community. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure.

slides.title: Here's the plan
dialogue: We'll do this in two parts:
**Conceptual planning** — you'll brainstorm what your event will actually focus on.
**Logistical planning** — you'll lock in the real details: when, where, who, how.
Throughout, you'll be giving me information. At the end, I'll turn it into a helpful planning doc and hand you off to my best friend ChatGPT to keep refining things.

slides.title: One last thing
dialogue: Oh yeah—I almost forgot. What campus are you at?
This helps both of us stay organized. You'll be able to keep track of your plan, and I'll know where to send good vibes.
